entities.name: Nicias of Miletus

entities.summary: Nicias of Miletus was an ancient Greek physician, poet and epigrammatist from Miletus. A confidant of Theocritus, he devoted himself to poetry and eight epigrams ascribed to his name survive in a fragmentary state.
